page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (faint, partly cut off) and right margin. Running head at top; a section heading "SACRA" in the middle; a second section beginning "ROMANÆ Ecclesiæ"; marginal notes at right: "Bulan.", "Pictorum"-type side notes, "Sigebertus in Chronico", "Photius in Bibliotheca".
page.running_head: LIB. III. Iustinianus Thrax & Tiberius II.

main_text.p: one, ad invadendas Guntrani terras milius Brunechildis, Sigeberti viduæ, Rothomagum, legatæ, amore irretitus eam in uxorem duxit; ideo à parre in cultodiam missus, mox ... plus receptusque, inde Novercæ interfectus est. Regnum vaque penes Chilpericum manet.

In SCOTIA excepit Congallum † Kinarium & hunc * Aidanus Goranus Filius. De Scotia occurrit, funtetiam qui, eo omisso, Aidanum Congallo subjiciunt. Ille regia à Columbano, ... tum autoritatis viro, insignia accepit, ... ones in Gallovidia, ducibus ipsorum supplices ... , compescuit, & bellum cum Pictis, ... editiosos, qui regios ministros, eos in ius ... pulsallent, ex fœdere tradere nolunt, ... quod tamen brevi Columbani authoritate ... ctum est.

Ex Doll floruere Gildas Anglus, qui sui ... poris historiam scripsit. Venantius Fortunatus, Duplabilis dictus, qui gesta Sanctorum ... fa tum carmine edidit: Bandamonia, S. Radegundis alumna, quæ librum de ea reliquit. Tum ... iam lupi Burdegalam ingressi, nemine ... ctuentes, canes devoravere.
main_text.head: SACRA.

ROMANÆ Ecclesiæ in hujus, quod ... simus, temporis initiis adhuc præfuit Johannes, ... quem excepere † Benedictus & † Pelagius. Et ad- ... vivente, Johannes Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus de Trinitate, ... consubstantiali ... habuit.

page.notes: Text is heavily damaged and faint; many words are illegible in the scan and have been left as ellipses where unreadable. Marginal notes at left and right are only partly legible: "Bulan.", "Pictorum", "Sigeberti in Chronico", "Photius in Bibliotheca". Number of letters not determinable for damaged segments. Some lines were run together where the scan is unclear and should be checked against the original.
